norm: the instantiation and lifecycle management follows the usual service provider pattern of ara diag
assumption: The instantiation and lifecycle management follows the usual service provider pattern of ara::diag.
rationale: Diagnostic service providers in AUTOSAR Adaptive are provided by default during application initialization and are maintained until shutdown.

original.rationale: Die Diagnose-Dienstleister in AUTOSAR Adaptive werden standardmäßig während der Anwendungsinitialisierung bereitgestellt und bis zum Herunterfahren vorgehalten.
